name: upright-object
title: Stand an object upright
description: Make a lying object stand: pinch it, rotate its local up axis to vertical in the hand, and set it down upright on the same support.
use_when: A lying object must stand on its base again.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: lying
preconditions.meaning: Object on its side: longest axis within 60 deg of horizontal and vertical extent <= 60 % of its length.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: upright
postconditions.meaning: Object z axis within 20 deg of vertical.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

postconditions.name: hand_empty
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: upright
checks.meaning: Object z axis within 20 deg of vertical.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: hand_empty
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

checks.name: on
checks.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_postconditions.name: on
extra_postconditions.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.
extra_postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_paths.note: Set down where it lay: a free edge spot near the robot had no IK for the sideways grip the turn leaves on the upright object.

next.when: the standing object is then grasped by its top

fallback_for.when: a tall object fell over and its top pinch is gone

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
